add.text: Art. 3 Abs. 1 lit. a i.V.m. Art. 5 lit. a HKÜ
add.label: STATUTE

comment: HKÜ is a ratified treaty with an SR number -> STATUTE (clarifications batch 3); Art. 3 Abs. 1 lit. a i.V.m. Art. 5 lit. a HKÜ is one chain; BG-KKE is a Swiss federal act -> STATUTE. Outcome: the whole proceeding is a Fristwiederherstellungsgesuch and item 1 is the only ruling (nicht eingetreten) -> inadmissible; the clarification that a Fristwiederherstellungsgesuch is a side request does not fit when it is the only matter. 430 25 313 is a cantonal file number.
